name: logo-com
description: Create and browse logos, inspect colors, fonts and downloads, and read your LOGO.com account, domain health and website status. Generate one to four draft logo designs using existing AI credits. Account summaries work on free plans. Logo tools require premium access; domain and website details require a paid premium plan for the selected organization. Website publishing, DNS changes, subscription changes and credit purchases are not supported.

interface.longDescription:
Create logos and check your LOGO.com account from chat.

Generate one to four new logo designs from a business name and ideas. Browse up to 50 recently created saved logos owned by you in the selected organization, then inspect their colors, fonts, previews and available download files. New designs are drafts until you open them in the LOGO.com editor and save them.

Read your selected organization's account summary, plan, AI credit balances, domains, business email setup and websites. Inspect owned domain settings and live DNS health, or list websites and check publication and custom-domain status. These tools do not change DNS, read email messages, edit or publish websites, export a full brand kit, change subscriptions or purchase credits.

Account summaries work on free plans. Logo tools require premium access, and generation also requires creation permission and existing AI credits. Domain details, domain health and website details require a paid premium plan for the selected organization. Account plan flags alone do not guarantee access to those tools.
defaultPrompt: Create a logo for my coffee shop, Bean There
Show my account, AI credits, and website status
Check my domain's DNS health and explain any problems

positive.description: Read the selected organization account summary. Setup: a connected sample account with known plan, credit balances and product counts. This case also works on a free plan. Run in a fresh conversation.
positive.prompt: Show my LOGO.com account summary, including my plan, AI credit balances, domains, business email setup, websites and saved-logo count.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_account with no arguments. Summarize only returned account fields, balances, product lists and counts. Respect has_more and list limits; do not claim the returned lists are exhaustive when truncated. Describe business email setup without claiming access to messages. Do not treat is_premium alone as proof of eligibility for domain or website detail tools. Do not purchase credits or change the account.

positive.description: Browse and inspect a saved logo. Setup: the connected premium user owns at least one saved sample logo in the selected organization with known colors and fonts and working high-resolution PNG, transparent PNG, SVG and PDF downloads. Run in a fresh conversation.
positive.prompt: Show my recent saved logos with previews and editor links. For the first logo returned, show its colors and fonts and download links for high-resolution PNG, transparent PNG, SVG and PDF.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_logos with no arguments. Show at most 50 logos in returned order, respecting has_more without inventing pagination. Pass the first returned logo_id to get_logo. Present only returned colors, fonts, preview and editor URLs, and download file names, formats and URLs. During review open the four downloads and verify the selected logo and file formats. Report missing formats as unavailable. Do not guess IDs, access another user's logos or generate replacements.

positive.description: Inspect domain health and website status without changing them. Setup: the selected organization has a paid premium plan, at least one owned sample domain with known DNS configuration, and a sample website with known publication and custom-domain status. Seed these fixtures before review. Run in a fresh conversation.
positive.prompt: Check my first listed domain: show its settings and live DNS health, then explain any reported problems. List my websites and inspect the first returned site for publication and custom-domain status. Do not change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_account and use a domain it returns for get_domain and check_domain_health. Report returned expiry, auto-renew, DNS, nameservers, forwarding, linked-site and email status only when available. Explain health status and reported problems and fixes without changing DNS. Call get_site without site_id to list sites, then with the first returned site_id to inspect it. Report returned publication, URL and custom-domain status without editing or publishing. Respect list limits and has_more. Do not invent unavailable registrar settings or treat null as disabled. A PREMIUM_REQUIRED error must be reported accurately but does not pass this seeded positive case.

positive.description: Create one draft from a detailed brief. Setup: the connected premium account can create designs, has sufficient AI credits, and has no generation already running. This case consumes AI credits. Run in a fresh conversation and wait for completion before the next generation case.
positive.prompt: Create one minimal logo for my bakery, Rise & Crumb, with the slogan Baked daily, color #D97706, and a wheat-stalk icon. Show me the preview and a link to edit it.
positive.expected_behavior: Call generate_logos once for one design, passing the business name Rise & Crumb, the slogan Baked daily, a minimal style, the color #D97706 and a wheat-stalk icon idea from the prompt. If the job is pending, poll get_logo_generation with the returned job instead of starting another generation. On success, return exactly one design's preview and editor link, and explain that it is a draft until saved in the editor. Treat the brief as guidance rather than guaranteeing exact artwork. If the job is partial or failed, report the actual status; do not claim success or automatically start paid replacement work.

positive.description: Create the maximum supported batch and follow asynchronous progress. Setup: the connected premium account can create designs, has enough AI credits for four designs and preparation, and has no generation already running. This case consumes AI credits. Run in a fresh conversation after the previous generation finishes.
positive.prompt: Create four playful logo options for Northstar Cycling, a bicycle repair shop. Use navy #16324F and orange #F18F01, with a bicycle-wheel icon. Show all four previews and editor links when they are ready.
positive.expected_behavior: Make one generate_logos call for four designs, passing the business name Northstar Cycling, a bicycle repair shop industry, a playful style, the colors #16324F and #F18F01 and a bicycle-wheel icon idea from the prompt. While pending, poll the same job with get_logo_generation and keep the user informed without starting duplicate generations. On success, show four previews with matching editor links and explain that they are unsaved drafts. If the job is partial or failed, show only the designs that completed and explain the failures. Never invent results or automatically charge for a retry.

negative.description: Non-logo image request. Expected behavior: no LOGO.com tool is called, because standalone photo generation is not supported. The host may answer with its own capabilities or explain the limit, but must not turn the request into a LOGO.com logo-generation job.
negative.prompt: Create a photorealistic picture of a golden retriever surfing, with no text or branding.

negative.description: Another company's existing logo. Expected behavior: no LOGO.com tool is called, because LOGO.com can only access the connected user's own saved logos. The host may answer with its own capabilities, but must not pass a guessed logo_id or present a LOGO.com result as another company's official asset.
negative.prompt: Find Nike's official logo and give me its original SVG file.

negative.description: Unsupported purchase or subscription change. Expected behavior: explain that this plugin cannot upgrade subscriptions or purchase credits. Do not call LOGO.com tools, initiate checkout, supply a transactional link, or claim a purchase succeeded.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my LOGO.com subscription and buy more AI credits for me.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products, start subscriptions, purchase credits or process payments. Account summaries work on free plans. Logo tools require premium access; domain and website detail tools require a paid premium plan for the selected organization. Logo generation consumes existing AI credits.

publication.release_notes: Align the listing and review cases with all eight MCP tools: get_account, list_logos, get_logo, generate_logos, get_logo_generation, get_domain, check_domain_health and get_site. Clarify free account summaries, premium requirements, read-only domain and website access, and unsaved logo drafts. Generation uses existing AI credits.
